question: Which complete local tiling-wrapper exits, restoration writes and bounded helper effects must a replacement preserve?

scope.distinctReset: 0x8268CE90 is a separate reset/setup function, not the BeginTiling count/rectangle writer0x8269CE90.
scope.qualification: Complete direct store/call/return inventories for the eight main functions and selected helpers. Imported/transitive effects, aliases, backing lifetime and caller-live ABI remain qualified; no complete consume contract is established.

dependencies.use: Owns issue/completion domains, callback, allocator and deferred-record qualifications.
Owns retained token/link/parser and external-write boundaries.
Owns direct/alias reader limits, shared pools and payload-only mode readers.
Owns retained dirty-mask and ring/list observations.
Owns selected reset/display, gamma, request and notification observations.

currentEvidence.method: Serial foreground read-only queries through tools/run-headless.ps1; complete bounded raw-word ranges for the eight main bodies, narrow exact-function generated windows and selected handwritten reader windows. Native operands/branches/calls were compared with generated comments; no runtime or general execution oracle was used.
currentEvidence.inputQualification: Supported flat SHA2565C7A8C3AD9B6A9D39CC9BBF3DA5AB23015A568C65C723D298F846086324C4680; mapped [0x82000000,0x83210000) SHA256389EB006B1DCDE90C5DE775C92D67C18542B8FD9BD39845574206D4B213E9B13.470 differing bytes/60 ranges stayed in [0x827F3F50,0x827F4280), outside cited semantic words. currentEvidence.localCompleteness: The eight main native ranges contained1234 words,159 direct stores,95 direct BL sites including ABI thunks and225 branch targets. Each matched its generated instruction/comment locator. Seventeen selected exact functions contained256 direct stores grouped into86 guarded families. Complete local writes do not close unexpanded callees or indirect ingress.

beginAndEnd.begin: BeginTiling0x8269CE90 writes count G+0x31CC and copies count16-byte rectangles to G+0x31D0, with zero count leaving old rectangle bytes. It also writes aligned origins/dimensions, parameters, saved surface/state, flags, dirty/predicate state and token records. AC0A8 and retained host ReadGuestTiling read count/rectangles. Other local fields remain subject to the reader boundary below.
beginAndEnd.end: D320 performs its selected Resolve/surface/record work before AC218. D7D8/DB20 preserve alternate token, saved-state and dirty/mode effects; DB20 can call DA58. D320/DA58 translate nonzero AC218 into full64 FFFFFFFF8007000E after90040; success returns0. DB20 returns its selected DA58 result or0.
beginAndEnd.unknownFields: G+0x3338,+0x3374,+0x31B0,+0x31A8,+0x319C,+0x31A0,+0x2AB4/+0x2AB8, selected G+0x2ABD bit0x80 and final G+0x31B4 clear still require exact surviving-reader/alias contracts. Changed G+0x2880 width bits have a retained rebased ACC60 payload reader, but payload-only copying does not establish their necessity after command replacement.

publicationTail.branches: Failure bit2ABD&0x20 skips publication. Recording byte2ABC&0x80 can append the separate34E0 queue record. Nonrecording tiled G33B0!=0 emits a length/address pair; nontiled calls BCA8 then BD98 with r7=0, using its returned cursor. These effects precede the common tail.
publicationTail.nonrollover: Let r28 be the actual post-submit cursor and a=U(r28+31)&0xFFFFFFE0. If a<=G38 unsigned,0x8269C574 writes G3A50=a and0x8269C578 writes G30=U(a-4). Entry cursor alone is not an oracle for every branch.
publicationTail.rollover: Otherwise0x8269C55C writes G30=U(r28-4), then0x8269C564 calls C270(G,0). Prefailed C270 uses the4800-byte emergency buffer and returns0. Fresh success/failure updates cursor/limits/failure state and conditionally waits on then clears G3A5C. Preserve the exact selected exit or refuse rollover before mutation.
publicationTail.readers: Subsequent C400 reads G30/G3A50; C588 returns G30; shared allocator, snapshot/restore and wait clients consume the resulting state. Recording decoder/reclaim and allocator/wait/import effects remain unknown.

savedPublication.restore: B118 independently reads all six words at0x8269B118..0x8269B130, restores the six values at0x8269B134..0x8269B148, and writes G38=U(saved G34-160 decimal) at0x8269B14C. It has no calls or stack stores and preserves full incoming r3.
savedPublication.survival: AC0A8 calls B0E0 after C588. AC218 allocation failure calls B118 at0x826AC29C before clearing failurebit. The retained host EndTiling failure path also invokes B118. C400/C588/BCA8/B618/A6848/B818 and later B0E0 read restored pool/publication state. All six saved words remain needed while this path survives; there is no saved G38 in this set.

internalBrackets.begin: AC0A8 snapshots five old G3438 descriptor words into G344C..345C, initializes seven descriptors through C3E0, updates G33B0/33B4, emits a252-byte0x80 record with flags/count/rebased rectangles and advances G3440. It does not validate an arbitrary rectangle count against that fixed reservation.
internalBrackets.allocationOrder: AC218 optionally calls BAE8, then always calls B818 with148/40/48 dwords and alignment32/32/4 before reloading the failure bit. B818's existing-failure path can return0 without another allocation. Prior successful side-buffer allocations are not rolled back by a later failure.
internalBrackets.failure: AC218 clears G33B0/G33B4, calls B118, clears byte2ABD bit0x20 and returns full r3=1, skipping all B508/BF40/BCA8/BD98 calls on this arm.
internalBrackets.success: Finalize seven lists via B508, emit BF40 callback AC020, finalize BCA8, then optional/middle/final BD98 with r7=0/1/0. Middle is bypassed only for G541C==0 and byte2ABD bit2 set. Return r3=0 independently of intermediate BD98 cursor results.
internalBrackets.flags: Known AC218 callers D320 and DA58 pass only high CPU-mask bits orzero; BF40 normalizes (flags&6)==0 with OR6. They cannot supply the generic low4/no2 callback-suppression case. Actual delivery, count conservation and indirect ingress remain separate obligations.
internalBrackets.coherency: BAE8 returns count11*(a+b), a=(G2E30!=0x00000000FFFFFFFF), b=(G2ABE>>2)&1. Zero count or allocation failure writes count0 and leaves its address output untouched. Its atomic old-range exchange has a separate local frame and sentinel effect.

distinctReset.local: 0x8268CE90 has only stack/ABI direct stores. It calls C8E0(G,input+0x48); a nonzero result exits unchanged. On zero it calls C810,A60F8,A5EB8. A5EB8 success returns0; failure calls A60F8 again then returns full64 FFFFFFFF8007000E.
distinctReset.transitive: A60F8 conditionally unbinds/drains, Releases and clears G39EC/39F0/39E8. A5EB8 writes video dimensions before later creation failures; successful partial surface pointers remain until cleanup. It copies124 bytes toG34E8, changes G3528 and on success writes G4144=FFFFFFFF after selected gamma/notification effects. C8E0 frees/reconfigures ring/pool/B/S2 and performs registration, issue/completed and worker-lifecycle effects. These are not consequences of a no-store wrapper alone.
distinctReset.qualification: Preserve selected helper outputs/failures, resource lifetime and retained display/request readers or replace them coherently. Complete transitive creation/free/import/alias and nested-frame closure remains unproved.

nextDiscriminator: Bind retained bit/field readers for the explicit unknown local fields; do not convert direct-reader negatives or payload-only copies into omission.
Inspect selected C3E0, surface/state/Resolve helpers and their pointed outputs in bounded exact-context packets before claiming transitive exit completeness.
Bind actual allocator target, generation, free/reuse, recording decoder/reclaim and rollover wait outcomes; preserve or refuse those paths.
Prove nested stack/output/physical disjointness, caller-live registers and ordered host observations before omitting spills, packets or helpers.
guards: No selected nonstack write is proved omittable here. Needed is conditional on the named retained consumer, not permanent guest backing after complete reader replacement.
A local no-store wrapper, successful sampled exit or complete local instruction inventory does not establish transitive absence or consume admission.
Do not confuse0x8268CE90 reset with0x8269CE90 BeginTiling, saved G34 with G38, or dwords with bytes.
conclusion: Complete local wrapper, saved-publication and selected helper exits are enumerated. Six saved words, cursor/limit tails, failure ordering, records and retained state have concrete observations; transitive helpers, aliases, allocator/lifetime and ABI still constrain replacement.
